ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $ \triangle ABC \cong \triangle ADE$, where $AB=8$, $AC=5$, $BC=6$. What is the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle ADE$, AB=8, AC=5, BC=6,\\
thus AD=AB=8,\\
therefore CD=AD-AC=8-5=\boxed{3}.
